descriptions.w3d_f11a_team_changed_802997fc: Look up FE.TempTeamStore and return false on lookup failure. Compare the observed team grave, weapon and skill integers against User.Grave/User.SWeapon/User.Skill; compare each stored worm name against formatted User.HumanWorm%d properties, then compare flag and speech shared text against User.Flag/User.Speech.
